# RackSafe

> Training for warehouse and distribution center staff: first responder awareness, spill kit use, spill prevention, universal waste, RCRA generator and PPE, with guides to chemical storage and damaged packages.

RackSafe (https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Awareness, Spill Prevention, Universal Waste, RCRA Generator training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Recognize a hazardous release, get clear and report it. Enroll: https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099
- [OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training): $29.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 40 CFR 112. Preventing spills in storage, handling and loading. Enroll: https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training?buy=416
- [RCRA Universal Waste Handler Training](https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training): $34.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 273 (RCRA). Batteries, lamps and aerosol cans from operations and returns. Enroll: https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training?buy=602
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training](https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training): $134.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA). Hazardous waste generator training for damaged and returned chemical products. Enroll: https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training?buy=601

## Guides

- [Chemical storage in warehouses: segregation basics](https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/guides/chemical-storage-segregation-warehouse): Storing incompatible chemicals together turns a small leak into a fire or toxic gas. The basics.
- [Damaged and leaking packages: what warehouse staff should do](https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/guides/damaged-leaking-packages-warehouse): A punctured case or a puddle under a pallet. A step-by-step plan for the floor.
- [Returned and damaged batteries in the warehouse](https://warehouse.hazwoperosha.us/guides/returned-batteries-universal-waste): Lithium batteries from returns can overheat and catch fire. How to handle them.
